comparison.objective: Unfold and form a gable carton's pouring spout, ending before any pouring.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual manipulation of connected creased facets and stabilization of a folding package.
comparison.success_condition: Mouth ≥30 mm, tip and lip project ≥8 mm, carton supported and released for 3 s; broken creases invalidate.
comparison.reason: Tests crease-mediated shape formation. Its three-second released dwell resembles the candidate only generically.
